reason_for_start: Use baseline landmark at 2009 and calibration at 2011 for first test 2013; avoids relying on pre-2009 training snapshots in this run. Not proof earlier years unusable.
reason_for_end: 2025 is latest full Jan1+365 day follow-up before snapshot 2026-11-06.
scope: All eligible active permit rows each test year; no random row subsample.
limitations: Selected landmarks previously evaluated; retrospective stability assessment, not untouched test.
Fixed lag policy allows labels to mature but is not yet an optimized service update schedule.
Missing historical industry coverage and current-address reconstruction remain.
Candidate stays fixed regardless of best model each year; no automatic deployment.
